Definition: from G4862 and G4983; of a joint body, i.e. (figuratively) a fellow-member of the Christian community:--of the same body.
BiblicalUsage: Paul says the Gentiles are fellow-members of the same body, sharing one inheritance and one promise in Christ. The word joins two ideas at once: the same body, and full membership in it. Gentiles are not guests in Israel's house; they are family in Christ's.
TheologicalSignificance: This is the heart of the gospel's reach, I believe: one body, one promise, and no second-class citizens in Christ.
